editorial_style: English legal and scientific subject terms with simple Telugu connectors; one bilingual narration only

notes.scope: Latest integrated manifest Sections C and D only. Live lesson, questions, images and deployment were not changed.
corrections_and_flags: Removed duplicate mappings: st3-ca-2025-ramsar-cop15-f001, st3-ca-q007, st3-ca-q008, st3-int-b-q008, st3-int-b-q009 and st3-int-b-q003 appeared twice in the integrated section arrays.
The Section C source list was insufficient: BDA and WPA do not support forest-diversion, FRA, Wetlands Rules, CRZ, NPCA or CAMPA claims.
The phrase '100-km border exemption' is misleading. It is a conditional statutory exclusion for specified strategic linear projects within 100 km of an international border, LoC or LAC.
CRZ mangrove wording must follow the operative 2019 notification exactly: where the mangrove area exceeds 1,000 square metres, a 50-metre buffer along the mangroves is included in CRZ-I A.
NBWL scrutiny should not be described as covering every corridor project automatically; jurisdiction depends on the applicable statutory and judicial approval route.
Time-sensitive protected-area totals, Ramsar governance facts, BBNJ-linked current affairs and institutional status must be rechecked before each exam cycle.

PIB's 16 March 2026 NR7 release supports MoEFCC submission, 142 indicators, 23 targets and coordinated stakeholder inputs, but does not assign NR7 coordination to NBA. The unsupported NBA-specific claim was removed.

NPCA's official MoEFCC work page directly states 60:40 for States, 90:10 for North-Eastern States and 100% Central funding for Union Territories. The broader phrase 'Himalayan States' was removed because it was not directly supported by that primary page.
The 27 November 2023 protected-area snapshot is retained only as a clearly dated historical figure; it must not be presented as the current count.

Unsupported NBPGR claims of one-million designed capacity, a cryobank and ten regional stations were removed. ICAR's dated official statement supports the 1996 establishment, 0.47 million accessions and 12 regional stations as of 15 January 2025.

The unverified claim that COP15 adopted exactly 20 resolutions was removed. Official Ramsar pages directly support the COP15 dates and venue, Fifth Strategic Plan 2025-2034, Standing Committee 2025-2028 and Resolution XV.10.

sections.title: Forests, rights, wetlands and coastal regulation

paragraphs.en: This field combines land-use regulation with recognition of community rights. Forest-conservation law controls diversion of forest land, while the Forest Rights Act, 2006 recognises eligible pre-existing rights. The Wetlands Rules regulate specified wetlands and CRZ notifications regulate coastal stretches; their purposes and legal routes are distinct.
paragraphs.te: ఈ fieldలో land-use regulation, community rights రెండూ కలిసి పనిచేస్తాయి. Forest-conservation law, forest landను non-forest useకు మళ్లించడాన్ని control చేస్తుంది. Forest Rights Act, 2006 అర్హులైన forest dwellersకు ముందే ఉన్న rightsను గుర్తిస్తుంది. Wetlands Rules wetlandsను regulate చేస్తే, Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) notifications coastal areasను regulate చేస్తాయి. ఇవన్నీ environment protectionకు సంబంధించినవే అయినా, వాటి purpose, legal route ఒకటి కాదు.

paragraphs.en: The Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980 was renamed the Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, 1980 in 2023. Forest land covered by the Act generally requires prior Central Government approval before non-forest use. The provision for areas within 100 km of an international border, LoC or LAC is not a blanket exemption: it applies only to strategic linear projects of national importance and concerning national security that satisfy the Act. Other exclusions for defence, security and notified Left-Wing Extremism-affected areas also have specific limits and conditions.
paragraphs.te: Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980కు 2023లో **Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, 1980** అనే పేరు వచ్చింది. ఈ law వర్తించే forest landను non-forest purposeకు ఉపయోగించే ముందు సాధారణంగా Central Government prior approval అవసరం. International border, Line of Control (LoC) లేదా Line of Actual Control (LAC) నుంచి 100 km పరిధిలో ఉందనే కారణంతో ప్రతి projectకు exemption రాదు. Actలో చెప్పిన conditionsను meet చేసే national importance లేదా national securityకు సంబంధించిన strategic linear projectకే ఆ provision వర్తిస్తుంది. Defence, security, Left-Wing Extremism-affected areasకు సంబంధించిన ఇతర exclusions కూడా limited conditionsతోనే ఉంటాయి.

paragraphs.en: After forest diversion is approved, the user agency generally pays the cost of compensatory afforestation and Net Present Value. These funds are managed for statutory purposes through the National Fund, State Funds and their CAMPA authorities under the Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016. The Act replaced the earlier ad hoc arrangement created under Supreme Court directions with a permanent statutory framework.
paragraphs.te: Forest diversion approve అయిన తరువాత user agency సాధారణంగా compensatory afforestation cost, Net Present Value (NPV) చెల్లిస్తుంది. ఈ moneyని ordinary government revenueలా ఖర్చు చేయరు. Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016 ప్రకారం National Fund, State Funds మరియు వాటి CAMPA authorities statutory purposes కోసం manage చేస్తాయి. అంతకుముందు Supreme Court directions కింద ad hocగా ఉన్న CAMPA arrangementకు 2016 Act permanent statutory structure ఇచ్చింది.

paragraphs.en: The Forest Rights Act, 2006 recognises pre-existing rights of eligible Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers; it does not create a new charity. An Individual Forest Right relates to forest land occupied for habitation or self-cultivation, subject to the Act. A Community Forest Resource right enables the Gram Sabha or community to protect, regenerate, conserve, manage and sustainably use its customary forest resource. The Gram Sabha begins the claims process. In a Critical Wildlife Habitat, rights recognition and exclusion-based conservation can create conflict and must follow the statutory safeguards.
paragraphs.te: Forest Rights Act, 2006 కొత్తగా charity ఇవ్వదు; eligible Scheduled Tribes, Other Traditional Forest Dwellersకు గతం నుంచి ఉన్న rightsను recognise చేస్తుంది. Individual Forest Right (IFR) అనేది individual లేదా household నివసిస్తూ సాగు చేస్తున్న forest landతో సంబంధం కలిగి ఉంటుంది. Community Forest Resource (CFR) right ద్వారా Gram Sabha/community తన customary forest resourceను protect, regenerate, conserve, manage చేసి sustainably use చేయగలదు. Claims processను Gram Sabha ప్రారంభిస్తుంది. Critical Wildlife Habitatలో rights recognition, exclusion-based conservation మధ్య conflict రావచ్చు; రెండూ automaticగా harmonious అని భావించకూడదు.

paragraphs.en: Rule 5 of the Wetlands Rules, 2017 provides a Wetlands Authority for every State and Union Territory. In a State, the Minister in charge of environment, forests or wetlands is Chairperson and the Chief Secretary is Vice-Chairperson. In a Union Territory, the Administrator or Chief Secretary chairs it. This decentralised arrangement replaced the Central Wetlands Regulatory Authority under the 2010 Rules; there was no body called the National Wetland Regulatory Authority.
paragraphs.te: Wetlands Rules, 2017లో Rule 5 ప్రకారం ప్రతి State, Union Territoryకు Wetlands Authority ఉంటుంది. Stateలో environment, forests లేదా wetlands portfolio చూసే Minister Chairperson; Chief Secretary Vice-Chairperson. Union Territoryలో Administrator లేదా Chief Secretary chair చేస్తారు. ఈ decentralised system, 2010 Rulesలోని **Central Wetlands Regulatory Authority** స్థానంలో వచ్చింది. దాని పేరు ‘National Wetland Regulatory Authority’ కాదు.

paragraphs.en: A Ramsar Site has international recognition under the Convention on Wetlands. Notification and regulation under the Wetlands Rules, 2017 are separate domestic legal processes. A wetland may have either status, both, or neither; international designation and domestic restriction are not the same.
paragraphs.te: Ramsar Site అనేది Ramsar Convention కింద international recognition. Wetlands Rules, 2017 కింద notification, regulation మాత్రం domestic legal process. అందువల్ల ఒక wetlandకు Ramsar status మాత్రమే ఉండవచ్చు, domestic notification మాత్రమే ఉండవచ్చు, రెండూ ఉండవచ్చు లేదా రెండూ లేకపోవచ్చు. International label, domestic restriction ఒకటే కాదు.

paragraphs.en: The Wetlands Rules, 2017 are subordinate legislation under the Environment (Protection) Act. They prohibit or regulate specified activities in notified wetlands. The National Plan for Conservation of Aquatic Ecosystems is instead a Centrally Sponsored Scheme that supports lake and wetland conservation projects; it is not a statutory authority. It was formed in 2013 by merging the National Wetland Conservation Programme and National Lake Conservation Plan. MoEFCC states a funding pattern of 60:40 for States, 90:10 for North-Eastern States and 100% Central funding for Union Territories.
paragraphs.te: Wetlands (Conservation and Management) Rules, 2017 అనేవి Environment (Protection) Act కింద subordinate legislation. ఇవి notified wetlandsలో specified activitiesను prohibit లేదా regulate చేస్తాయి. National Plan for Conservation of Aquatic Ecosystems (NPCA) మాత్రం statutory authority కాదు; lakes, wetlands conservation projectsకు support ఇచ్చే Centrally Sponsored Scheme. National Wetland Conservation Programme, National Lake Conservation Planను merge చేసి 2013లో NPCAను ప్రారంభించారు. MoEFCC official funding statement ప్రకారం సాధారణ Statesకు Centre–State funding 60:40; North-Eastern Statesకు 90:10; Union Territoriesకు 100% Central funding.

paragraphs.en: CRZ and Eco-Sensitive Zones both derive authority from the Environment (Protection) Act, but regulate different landscapes. The CRZ Notification, 2019 classifies coastal areas and superseded the 2011 notification. An ESZ is a site-specific regulated belt around a protected area. The two instruments are not interchangeable.
paragraphs.te: CRZ, Eco-Sensitive Zone (ESZ) రెండూ Environment (Protection) Act నుంచి authority పొందినా, regulate చేసే landscape వేరు. CRZ Notification, 2019 coastను classify చేస్తుంది; అది 2011 notificationను replace చేసింది. ESZ మాత్రం protected area చుట్టూ site-specific regulated belt. ఒకే parent Act కింద ఉన్నాయనే కారణంతో CRZ, ESZను interchange చేయకూడదు.

paragraphs.en: Under the CRZ Notification, 2019, ecologically sensitive features fall in CRZ-I A and the inter-tidal zone in CRZ-I B. Developed urban coast is CRZ-II, while relatively undisturbed or rural coast is CRZ-III. The notified No Development Zone is 50 metres in densely populated CRZ-III A and 200 metres in CRZ-III B. Coastal and tidal-influenced waters fall in CRZ-IV. Questions should be answered using the category and threshold in the operative notification.
paragraphs.te: CRZ Notification, 2019లో ecologically sensitive features **CRZ-I A**లో, inter-tidal zone **CRZ-I B**లో ఉంటాయి. Developed urban coast **CRZ-II**; relatively undisturbed లేదా rural coast **CRZ-III**. Densely populated CRZ-III Aలో notified No Development Zone 50 metres; CRZ-III Bలో 200 metres. Coastal waters, tidal-influenced waters **CRZ-IV**లో వస్తాయి. Examలో operative notificationలోని category, thresholdనే ఉపయోగించాలి.

paragraphs.en: When a mangrove area exceeds 1,000 square metres, the CRZ Notification, 2019 places it in CRZ-I A and also includes the specified 50-metre buffer along the mangroves in CRZ-I A. The threshold and buffer should not be mechanically applied to every smaller mangrove patch.
paragraphs.te: Mangrove area 1,000 square metresకంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉంటే, CRZ Notification, 2019 దాన్ని CRZ-I Aగా classify చేస్తుంది; mangroves వెంట specified 50-metre bufferను కూడా CRZ-I Aలో చేర్చుతుంది. ఈ area threshold, bufferను ప్రతి చిన్న mangrove patchకు mechanically apply చేయకూడదు.

paragraphs.en: Do not confuse a statutory fund mechanism with an executive scheme. CAMPA has a statutory basis under the Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016, whereas NPCA is a scheme. NGT jurisdiction is limited to enactments listed in Schedule I of the NGT Act, which does not include the Wild Life (Protection) Act. A wildlife dispute usually reaches the NGT only when it also raises a substantial environmental question under a listed law such as the Environment (Protection) Act, forest-conservation law or Biological Diversity Act.
paragraphs.te: Legal statusను schemeతో కలపకూడదు. CAMPAకు Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016 కింద statutory basis ఉంది; NPCA executive scheme. అలాగే NGT jurisdiction, NGT Act Schedule Iలో listed enactmentsకే పరిమితం. Wild Life (Protection) Act ఆ Scheduleలో లేదు. కాబట్టి wildlife disputeలో EPA, forest-conservation law, Biological Diversity Act వంటి listed lawకు సంబంధించిన substantial environmental question కూడా ఉన్నప్పుడే NGT route సాధారణంగా తెరుచుకుంటుంది.

paragraphs.en: Ramsar COP15 was held at Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe, from 23 to 31 July 2025. It adopted the Fifth Strategic Plan for 2025–2034. The Standing Committee elected at COP15 serves the 2025–2028 triennium, and Resolution XV.10 sets the scientific and technical work framework for 2025–2028. These are international governance facts and do not replace regulation under India's Wetlands Rules.
paragraphs.te: Ramsar COP15, 23–31 July 2025 మధ్య Victoria Falls, Zimbabweలో జరిగింది. అది Fifth Strategic Plan 2025–2034ను adopt చేసింది. Current Standing Committee term 2025–2028; Resolution XV.10 scientific, technical workకు 2025–2028 prioritiesను ఇచ్చింది. ఇవి international governance facts మాత్రమే; Ramsar designationను Indian Wetlands Rules regulationతో merge చేయవు.

paragraphs.en: India's environmental institutions do not exercise the same authority. NBWL advises and reviews; NTCA oversees tiger-reserve governance; NGT adjudicates specified disputes. Policy, regulation, administration, research, monitoring and adjudication should be separated. National importance alone does not make an institution statutory; legislation must create or authorise it.
paragraphs.te: Indiaలో environmental institutions అన్నీ ఒకే authorityను exercise చేయవు. NBWL advice, review చేస్తుంది; NTCA Tiger Reserve governanceను supervise చేస్తుంది; NGT specified disputesను adjudicate చేస్తుంది. Policy, regulation, administration, research, monitoring, adjudication అనే rolesను ముందుగా వేరు చేసి చదవాలి. ఒక institution national importance కలిగి ఉన్నంత మాత్రాన statutory body కాదు; legislation దాన్ని create లేదా authorise చేసినప్పుడే statutory status వస్తుంది.

paragraphs.en: MoEFCC is the Union Government's nodal ministry for environment, forests and wildlife. It frames central policy and supervises specialised bodies or receives their reports. It functions under the Allocation of Business Rules and is not an authority created by one environmental statute.
paragraphs.te: MoEFCC, environment, forests, wildlife విషయాల్లో Union Government nodal ministry. Central policyని frame చేసి, specialised bodiesను supervise చేస్తుంది లేదా వాటి reportsను receive చేస్తుంది. ఇది Allocation of Business Rules కింద పనిచేసే Ministry; ఒక particular environmental statute create చేసిన authority కాదు.

paragraphs.en: The National Biodiversity Authority in Chennai is a statutory body established by the Central Government under section 8 of the Biological Diversity Act. It regulates access by persons covered by section 3(2), oversees Access and Benefit-sharing arrangements and advises the Central Government.
paragraphs.te: Chennaiలోని National Biodiversity Authority (NBA), Biological Diversity Act section 8 కింద Central Government ఏర్పాటు చేసిన statutory body. Section 3(2) పరిధిలోని persons biological resources లేదా associated knowledgeను access చేసే సందర్భాలను regulate చేయడం, Access and Benefit-sharing (ABS) arrangementsను oversee చేయడం, Central Governmentకు advice ఇవ్వడం దీని ప్రధాన functions.

paragraphs.en: The National Board for Wild Life is the apex statutory advisory body under section 5A of the Wild Life (Protection) Act, with the Prime Minister as Chairperson. Its Standing Committee scrutinises proposals affecting protected areas when the applicable approval route requires it. Field authorities, not NBWL, conduct day-to-day protected-area management.
paragraphs.te: National Board for Wild Life (NBWL), WPA section 5A కింద ఉన్న apex statutory advisory body; Prime Minister దీనికి Chairperson. Protected areasను ప్రభావితం చేసే proposalsను applicable approval routeలో దాని Standing Committee scrutinise చేస్తుంది. NBWL advice, review చేస్తుంది; day-to-day protected-area management field authorities పని.

paragraphs.en: The National Tiger Conservation Authority is the statutory tiger-governance authority under section 38L of the Wild Life (Protection) Act. It oversees standards, tiger conservation plans and specified approvals for Tiger Reserves. It is distinct from WII's research role, NBWL's advisory role and wildlife funding schemes.
paragraphs.te: National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA), WPA section 38L కింద statutory tiger-governance authority. Tiger Reservesకు standards, conservation plans, approvalsను oversee చేస్తుంది. ఇది WII research role కాదు; NBWL advisory role కాదు; wildlife funding scheme కూడా కాదు.

paragraphs.en: The Wildlife Crime Control Bureau coordinates intelligence and enforcement against organised wildlife crime. Section 38Y of the Wild Life (Protection) Act establishes this statutory Bureau; section 38XA is a savings provision, not its constituting section.
paragraphs.te: Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (WCCB), organised wildlife crimeపై intelligence, enforcement coordination చేస్తుంది. WPA section 38Y ఈ statutory Bureauను create చేసింది. Section 38XA savings provision మాత్రమే; WCCB constituting section కాదు.

paragraphs.en: The Central Zoo Authority recognises and regulates Indian zoos and sets zoo-management standards. Its work also includes ex-situ conservation, conservation breeding and Species Survival Plans. Section 38A, inserted by the 1991 amendment to the Wild Life (Protection) Act, gives it statutory status.
paragraphs.te: Central Zoo Authority (CZA), Indian zoosను recognise, regulate చేసి zoo-management standardsను set చేస్తుంది. Ex-situ conservation, conservation breeding, Species Survival Plans కూడా దీని workలో భాగం. 1991 Amendmentతో వచ్చిన WPA section 38A, CZAకు statutory basis ఇచ్చింది.

paragraphs.en: The Wildlife Institute of India in Dehradun is a national institution for wildlife research and training. It develops population-estimation and monitoring methods, supports management planning and maintains the National Wildlife Database. Established in 1982 and autonomous from April 1986, it is an autonomous MoEFCC institution rather than a statutory body.
paragraphs.te: Wildlife Institute of India (WII), Dehradun wildlife research, trainingకు national institution. Population-estimation, monitoring methodsను develop చేసి management planningకు support ఇస్తుంది; National Wildlife Databaseను maintain చేస్తుంది. 1982లో establish అయి April 1986 నుంచి autonomousగా పనిచేస్తున్న WII, MoEFCC autonomous institution; statutory body కాదు.

paragraphs.en: The Botanical Survey of India and Zoological Survey of India, both headquartered in Kolkata, survey, explore, classify and inventory plants and animals respectively. Their taxonomic work documents known diversity and helps identify previously unrecorded species. Both are non-statutory subordinate offices of MoEFCC.
paragraphs.te: Kolkataలోని Botanical Survey of India (BSI), Zoological Survey of India (ZSI) వరుసగా plants, animalsపై survey, exploration, classification, inventory చేస్తాయి. Taxonomic work ద్వారా known diversityను document చేసి, unrecorded speciesను identify చేయడంలో సహాయపడతాయి. రెండూ MoEFCC subordinate offices; statutory authorities కావు.

paragraphs.en: The Forest Survey of India in Dehradun monitors forest and tree resources through satellite forest-cover mapping, the National Forest Inventory and forest-fire alerts. Its flagship publication is the biennial India State of Forest Report. FSI was created on 1 June 1981 as successor to the Pre-Investment Survey of Forest Resources begun in 1965. It is a non-statutory subordinate office of MoEFCC.
paragraphs.te: Forest Survey of India (FSI), Dehradun satellite forest-cover mapping, National Forest Inventory, forest-fire alerts ద్వారా forest and tree resourcesను monitor చేస్తుంది. Biennial India State of Forest Report దీని flagship publication. 1965లోని Pre-Investment Survey of Forest Resourcesకు successorగా 1 June 1981న FSI ఏర్పడింది. ఇది non-statutory MoEFCC subordinate office.

paragraphs.en: ICAR–National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources in New Delhi is India's nodal institution for plant genetic resources. It collects, quarantines, characterises and evaluates germplasm and conserves it ex situ in the National Genebank. India's first National Genebank was established there in 1996; official ICAR information reported 0.47 million accessions and 12 regional stations as of 15 January 2025. Such operational totals are date-specific.
paragraphs.te: ICAR–National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (NBPGR), New Delhi plant genetic resourcesకు nodal institution. Germplasm collection, quarantine, characterisation, evaluation చేసి, National Genebankలో ex-situగా conserve చేస్తుంది. India's first National Genebankను 1996లో ఇక్కడ establish చేశారు. ICAR official information ప్రకారం 15 January 2025 నాటికి 0.47 million accessions, 12 regional stations ఉన్నాయి. ఇవి date-specific operational figures.

paragraphs.en: SACON near Anaikatty, Coimbatore specialises in ornithology and natural history. It supports research on birds and habitats, ornithological information and postgraduate and doctoral training. SACON is an autonomous MoEFCC institution, not a statutory authority. National roles do not by themselves make FSI, NBPGR or SACON statutory.
paragraphs.te: Anaikatty, Coimbatore సమీపంలోని SACON, ornithology, natural historyలో specialise చేస్తుంది. Birds, habitatsపై research, national ornithological information, postgraduate–doctoral trainingకు support ఇస్తుంది. SACON autonomous MoEFCC institution; statutory authority కాదు. FSI, NBPGR, SACONకు national roles ఉన్నా express legislative basis లేకపోవడంతో non-statutoryగానే ఉంటాయి.

paragraphs.en: The National Green Tribunal, established in 2010, is a specialised adjudicatory forum. It hears substantial environmental questions arising under the seven enactments listed in Schedule I of the NGT Act; it does not make policy or manage sites. Because the Wild Life (Protection) Act is not in Schedule I, a wildlife issue alone does not automatically confer jurisdiction; there must also be an overlapping issue under a listed enactment.
paragraphs.te: National Green Tribunal (NGT), 2010లో ఏర్పడిన specialised adjudicatory forum. NGT Act Schedule Iలోని seven enactments కింద వచ్చే substantial environmental questionsను hear చేస్తుంది. Policy తయారు చేయడం లేదా field management దీని పని కాదు. WPA Schedule Iలో లేకపోవడంతో wildlife issue మాత్రమే ఉన్న dispute automaticగా NGT jurisdictionలోకి రాదు; listed law కింద overlapping issue కూడా అవసరం.

paragraphs.en: National and State CAMPA bodies manage funds collected from forest diversion for compensatory afforestation and related restoration. The Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016 gave statutory form to the earlier ad hoc arrangement created under Supreme Court directions.
paragraphs.te: CAMPA national, State bodies forest diversion నుంచి collect చేసిన fundsను compensatory afforestation, related restorationకు manage చేస్తాయి. Supreme Court-directed ad hoc arrangementకు Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016 statutory form ఇచ్చింది.

paragraphs.en: Protected-area totals must always carry a date. A PIB release of 3 March 2025 reproduced the National Wildlife Database snapshot of 27 November 2023: 106 National Parks, 573 Wildlife Sanctuaries, 115 Conservation Reserves and 220 Community Reserves, totalling 1,014 protected areas and 5.32% of India's geographical area. These figures are historical, not current; Tiger Reserve, Biosphere Reserve and Ramsar totals also change. This dated national share is not the same measure as the global 30×30 target.
paragraphs.te: Protected-area numbersను date లేకుండా quote చేయకూడదు. 3 March 2025 PIB release, National Wildlife Databaseలోని 27 November 2023 snapshotను reproduce చేసింది: 106 National Parks, 573 Wildlife Sanctuaries, 115 Conservation Reserves, 220 Community Reserves—మొత్తం 1,014 protected areas; India's geographical areaలో 5.32%. Tiger Reserve, Biosphere Reserve, Ramsar totals కూడా recognition మారినప్పుడల్లా మారతాయి. ఈ dated national percentage, global 30×30 target ఒకే measure కాదు.

paragraphs.en: India's biodiversity-planning sequence is: the 1999 macro-level strategy, Cabinet-approved NBAP 2008, the 2014 Addendum and NBSAP 2024–2030. India did not replace NBAP 2008 when the CBD adopted 20 Aichi Targets. The 2014 Addendum collectively incorporated those targets into 12 Indian National Biodiversity Targets; the mapping was not one-to-one.
paragraphs.te: India biodiversity-planning sequence: 1999 macro-level strategy → Cabinet-approved NBAP 2008 → 2014 Addendum → NBSAP 2024–2030. CBDలో 20 Aichi Targets వచ్చిన తరువాత India NBAP 2008ను replace చేయలేదు. 2014 Addendum, 12 Indian National Biodiversity Targetsలో మొత్తం 20 Aichi Targetsను collectively absorb చేసింది; mapping one-to-one కాదు.

paragraphs.en: India released NBSAP 2024–2030 at CBD COP16 in Cali on 30 October 2024. Its 23 National Biodiversity Targets align with the 23 targets of the KMGBF and use 2030 and 2050 horizons. India treats Target 3 as a collective global goal rather than an identical national quota; qualifying OECMs may contribute without becoming protected areas under the Wild Life (Protection) Act.
paragraphs.te: India, NBSAP 2024–2030ను 30 October 2024న Cali CBD COP16లో release చేసింది. ఇందులో 23 National Biodiversity Targets, KMGBFలోని 23 targetsతో align అవుతూ 2030, 2050 horizonsను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి. India, Target 3ను identical national quotaగా కాక collective global goalగా చూస్తుంది; qualifying OECMs, WPA protected areasగా మారకుండానే contribute చేయవచ్చు.

paragraphs.en: The Seventh National Report should be read as a dated Government self-assessment, not an independent evaluation. MoEFCC submitted it to the CBD on 26 February 2026. It uses 142 national indicators mapped to 23 National Biodiversity Targets and draws on coordinated inputs from ministries, States, statutory authorities and research institutions. SBBs support State-level implementation, while BMCs and People's Biodiversity Registers provide local evidence.
paragraphs.te: Seventh National Reportను dated Government self-assessmentగా చదవాలి; independent evaluationగా కాదు. MoEFCC ఈ reportను 26 February 2026న CBDకు submit చేసింది. ఇందులో 23 National Biodiversity Targetsకు map చేసిన 142 national indicators ఉన్నాయి; Ministries, States, statutory authorities, research institutions ఇచ్చిన coordinated inputsను ఉపయోగించింది. SBBs State-level implementationకు support చేస్తాయి; BMCs, People's Biodiversity Registers ద్వారా local evidenceను అందిస్తాయి.
